$schema-note: Sample 'blocker directory' for the find_help skill. Copy this, edit the entries to match your org's real owners/links, then point usageLogger.blockerDirectoryPath at your copy (or paste entries into the usageLogger.blockerDirectory setting). All links must be https/http/msteams/mailto; anything else is dropped. Everything here is a placeholder.

routes.title: GCP project / IAM access
routes.summary: Getting or elevating access to a GCP project, dataset, or resource.
steps: Raise the 'GCP Access Request' item in the ServiceNow catalogue.
Have your line manager approve the request.
Post in the Cloud Platform Teams channel if it's blocking a release.

routes.title: VPN / network connectivity
routes.summary: VPN not connecting, corporate proxy issues, or a host that won't resolve/route.
steps: Check the IT status page for a known outage first.
Reconnect the VPN client / restart the machine.
If still blocked, raise a 'Network Connectivity' incident.

routes.title: Confluence / Jira access
routes.summary: Access to a Confluence space or Jira project/board.

routes.title: GitHub org / repository access
routes.summary: Joining the GitHub org, repo permissions, or authorising SSO for the org.

routes.title: Copilot licence / premium requests
routes.summary: Requesting a Copilot seat, or questions about premium-request allowance/quota.

routes.title: Local dev environment setup
routes.summary: First-time environment setup, toolchain install, and getting a local build running.
steps: Follow the Developer Setup Guide top to bottom.
Ask your assigned onboarding buddy for anything environment-specific.
Raise a ticket only if a step needs an access you can't self-serve.
